evidenceRequirements.candidateFreezeRule: exactly one frozen candidate per evidence round; once frozen, later phases produce only qualification/evidence; a real problem means a new candidate and fresh candidate-bound evidence
evidenceRequirements.requiredArtifactBinding: the seven-artifact Stage 8 evidence pattern (fresh-install, migration, backup-restore, mounted-runner-raw, smoke, promotion-plan-validation, manifest) with LF-byte SHA-256 and byte counts, current-run runId/node IDs/TLS/browser bindings, and no historical rebinding
evidenceRequirements.reverseConnectionMatrixRequired: a reverse-connection acceptance matrix must be defined in the RFC and mechanically enforced by the harness before the v0.5 mounted evidence run
evidenceRequirements.closureRule: one evidence-only closure, direct child of the frozen candidate, attestation must not reference its own closure SHA
